amountCents.description: Credit quantity this claim returns, with up to six decimal places.

capCents.description: Maximum credit quantity this claim can return, with up to six decimal places.

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the decision, or null while none was taken.

incidentId.description: The incident this claim was filed against.

measuredCents.description: Credit quantity this number consumed inside the window, with up to six decimal places.

paidAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the credits landed, or null.

phoneNumber.description: The customer's own number in E.164 format.

reason.description: One sentence describing what the ban was attributed to.

status.description: Where the claim sits. filed and under_review are open. approved means it was accepted, and with a zero amount that there was nothing to return. paid means the credits are on your balance. reversed means what Polymorfa knew about the ban changed afterwards and the credits were taken back.

summary.description: One sentence describing the claim's state.

verdict.description: What the ban was attributed to. other_device: another device on the account was sending. customer_conduct: Polymorfa was already restricting this number, or named the same serious problem for a week. shared_network: the number shared its connection with numbers that were being restricted. ours: nothing points at how the number was used. inconclusive: Polymorfa could not see enough of the window to say. simultaneous_calls: simultaneous calls were on for the number inside the window, which voids Ban Insurance; the claim is denied when filed.

windowEnd.description: ISO 8601 end of the window: the moment the ban started.

windowStart.description: ISO 8601 start of the 30 days the refund covers.
